**A hotfix for v0.77.** The same game with one sound fix. If v0.77 sounds fine
to you, there is no need to update.

**Random pitch is now a switch, and off by default.** Effects no longer start
a little higher or lower each time, so every shot sounds the same, the DOOM
most people know. The wobble of the earliest versions is still there:
F4 → Sound → Random pitch. DOOM only; Heretic keeps its own slight variation.

**Moving sounds keep their pitch.** With the switch on, a sound from something
moving no longer snaps back to normal pitch just after it starts.
